title: Insecure temporary file via tempfile.mktemp (python) — review required
description: The python call tempfile.mktemp creates temporary files with predictable names or unsafe semantics, so a local attacker can pre-create or replace the file (symlink attacks). This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms exclusive creation or switches to tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile.
remediation: Create temporary files with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile, which opens exclusively with tight permissions.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any tempfile.mktemp call matches regardless of directory protections.
